mapper.select: SELECT id FROM task_info WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND scheduled_time <= NOW(3) ORDER BY scheduled_time LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE task_info SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, last_failure_kind = #{lastFailureKind}, next_retry_time = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE task_info SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1,
scheduled_time = DATE_ADD( NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delayMillis} * 1000 MICROSECOND), next_retry_time = DATE_ADD( NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delayMillis} * 1000 MICROSECOND), error_msg = #{errorMsg}, last_failure_kind = #{failureKind}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE task_info SET status = 'PENDING', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_time < NOW(3) ORDER BY lease_expire_time LIMIT #{limit}
UPDATE task_info SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE task_info SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, scheduled_time = NOW(3), next_retry_time = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, redrive_by = #{redriveBy}, redrive_reason = #{redriveReason}, redrive_at = NOW(3), updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_info GROUP BY status
